'''Ixa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She worked as an aide to [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Oleg Klerren]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] that Anchorhead was the target of terrorist attacks using bomb-carrying local [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
